metadata.description: Android app giving one newspaper deliverer a street-by-street overview of which addresses receive the newspaper and/or leaflets, based on mailbox stickers.

milestones.title: Preparation (plan Phase 0)
milestones.notes: Wireframes approved. Remaining: walk the real route once to note stickers and walking order (user).

milestones.title: Foundation complete (end of Phase 1)
milestones.notes: FND-001, FND-003, FND-004 complete; FND-002 remaining

milestones.title: MVP: a round can be walked (end of Phase 3)
milestones.notes: Exit: a full round can be walked with the live list (check-offs dropped, DEC-014).

milestones.title: Validated in the field (Phase 5)
milestones.notes: Two consecutive weeks without a wrong delivery caused by the app.

milestones.title: v1.0 release (Phase 7)
milestones.notes: Dutch translation review, final signed APK, limited-distribution developer verification registered before the 2027 global rollout.

features.title: Project and build setup
features.description: Android project with Gradle Kotlin DSL, version catalog, Hilt, package structure (data, domain, ui.editor, ui.round, ui.settings), GitHub Actions CI (lint, unit tests, signed release APK artefact), release signing config.
acceptance_criteria: Project builds with ./gradlew assembleDebug
minSdk 26, targetSdk latest stable (researched at setup time)
No INTERNET permission in the merged manifest
CI runs lint + unit tests and produces a signed release APK
Release keystore created and user reminded to back it up in two places

Package skeleton app nl.ericmulder.krantenwijk (debug suffix .debug)

features.title: App shell: theme, navigation, localisation
features.description: Material 3 theme (light/dark/system) meeting outdoor contrast targets, navigation skeleton for all screens in §6, EN default + NL string resources from day one, locales_config for per-app language.
acceptance_criteria: Theme follows system and can be forced light/dark
App launches in Dutch on a Dutch device, English on an unsupported locale (e.g. German)
App appears in Android 13+ per-app language settings
Lint fails on hard-coded strings and missing translations

features.title: Domain rules with full unit tests
features.description: Pure Kotlin domain functions: deliveryFor(sticker), deliveryFor(address, round), generateRange, generateUnits, natural suffix sort, address sort with direction, buildingSummary. No Android dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Every row of the sticker table (§3.3) covered by tests
Non-existing address always yields nothing; round without leaflets yields no leaflets
Range cases: 2-24 even, 1-24 even starts at 2, from == to, single-sided
Sorting: 12, 12A, 12B, 13; natural suffix sort 1, 2, 10; descending direction
Units: A-L = 12, A-Z = 26, 1-20 numeric
domain package has no android.* imports

done: domain.model: Sticker, Delivery, RoundContents, Side, Direction, Address, SuffixType
domain.rules: deliveryFor(sticker), deliveryFor(address, round), generateRange/checkRange/countInRange, generateUnits, NaturalOrder/AddressNumberOrder/inWalkingOrder, stickerSummary/deliverySummary
68 unit tests passing (JUnit Jupiter); mutation check: breaking NEE_JA rule and adding android import both fail tests
DomainPurityTest enforces no android/androidx/dagger imports in domain
DEC-012 revised per user: ranges low to high only; reverse walking = per-segment checkbox
notes: 'Building done' + undo tests (plan §10) belong to RND-D, since they need RoundItems
generateUnits throws on invalid input; BLD-01 will add a checkUnits() for UI messages, like checkRange()

features.title: Persistence: Room schema v1 and settings
features.description: Room entities Route, Segment, Building, Address, Round, RoundItem (§5) with DAOs and repositories exposing Flow; DataStore for nickname, onboardingCompleted, theme, display options. Schema export enabled for migration tests.
acceptance_criteria: In-memory Room tests for all DAOs
Schema v1 JSON exported to the repo
Writes committed immediately (no deferred batching)

done: KMP :core module (android + jvm), domain + tests moved from :app (DEC-013)
DAOs incl. @Transaction insertWithAddresses/reorder/deleteAndCompact/insertWithItems
RouteRepository + SettingsRepository interfaces (domain) with Room/DataStore implementations
Hilt DataModule in :app; placeholder screen reads the route from the DB (device smoke test)
Room 2.8.5 KMP schema v1: route, segment, building, address (round tables removed per DEC-014)
90 JVM tests passing (68 domain + 22 data: repository, durability, settings, schema)
sqlite pinned to 2.6.2 (Intel Mac host binary); :core `test` alias so `./gradlew test` runs everything
CI green on 74efbf0 (run 36617729410)
User installed CI release APK on phone: opens with placeholder (Room + bundled SQLite + R8 work on device)
notes: RoundRepository (start round from snapshot, check-off) is built in RND-A/RND-C on top of RoundDao
Building creation logic (turn number into building, units) is BLD-A; DAO support exists

features.title: Add street section with live preview
features.description: Add/edit segment screen: street name with autocomplete, side, from/to with swap, live preview of generated numbers, side-mismatch warning, validation.
acceptance_criteria: See plan ADR-02, ADR-07, ADR-11
notes: DEC-012: from/to entered low to high (reject from > to); replace prototype swap button with a 'walk in reverse order' checkbox

features.title: Number check screen and address editing
features.description: Post-preview number check grid and segment detail: delete numbers, add single numbers and additions, mark/unmark 'does not exist', turn a number into a building (hand-off to BLD-A).
acceptance_criteria: See plan ADR-12, ADR-03, ADR-04

features.title: Route editor: order and direction
features.description: Route editor listing segments in walking order with drag-and-drop reordering and ascending/descending toggle per segment.
acceptance_criteria: See plan ADR-05, ADR-06

features.title: Stickers per address with bulk edit
features.description: Sticker selector per address (none, JA, NEE/JA, NEE/NEE), multi-select bulk sticker change, delivery indicators (icon + colour) next to each address.
acceptance_criteria: See plan STK-01..03

features.title: Create apartment building, collapsed row
features.description: Create a building from a house number plus suffix range (letters or numbers with separator), with preview; show it as one row with apartment count and sticker summary.
acceptance_criteria: See plan BLD-01, BLD-02

features.title: Building grid (zoom in) and bulk edit
features.description: Building detail grid of apartment tiles (suffix + sticker), quick sticker picker, multi-select/select-all bulk edit, add/delete apartments.
acceptance_criteria: See plan BLD-03..05; 26 tiles fit one portrait phone screen

features.title: First-launch wizard and home screen
features.description: Four-step guided setup (nickname, route + town, street sections loop, walking order) reusing the section/number-check screens, then home screen with route name, sticker overview entry and Start round button.
acceptance_criteria: See plan ADR-01
Phase 2 exit: the real route, including buildings, can be entered in under 45 minutes (user test)

features.title: Round start: choose contents, counts to take along
features.description: Round start screen with newspaper/leaflets toggles; take-along counts calculated from the live address list (deliverySummary). No snapshot, nothing stored per round (DEC-014).
acceptance_criteria: See plan RND-01, RND-02

features.title: Round list in walking order (live)
features.description: Live list of addresses grouped by segment in walking order with four distinct delivery states (icon + colour); skipped houses dimmed with toggle; non-existing hidden by default; screen kept on. Always reflects current route data (DEC-014).
acceptance_criteria: See plan RND-03, RND-04, RND-08; smooth scroll with 1,000 addresses

features.title: Check-off, progress and persistence
features.description: Tap to mark done with undo, progress indicator, auto-focus next delivery, round state survives force-close and restart.
acceptance_criteria: See plan RND-05..07, RND-09
notes: Dropped by user 2026-09-29 (DEC-014): no check-offs, progress or round persistence (RND-05/06/07/09)

features.title: Buildings in round mode (live counts, inline expand)
features.description: Building row shows per-round counts from the live apartments and expands inline to the per-apartment list; apartments receiving nothing are dimmed. No per-apartment check-off (BLD-07 dropped, DEC-014).
acceptance_criteria: See plan BLD-06

features.title: Backup export and restore
features.description: Full route export to JSON via Storage Access Framework and import/restore; versioned backup format with kotlinx.serialization.
acceptance_criteria: Export -> uninstall -> reinstall -> import yields an identical route

features.title: Settings screen and release pipeline
features.description: Settings screen (theme, show/hide non-existing and skipped, keep screen on, backup/restore entry, version + build number), local crash log with export, signed release APK and install/update instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Release APK installs and updates over itself on the user's phone without data loss

features.title: Compact 'next up' view
notes: Open question (DEC-014): 'next 3 deliveries' assumed check-offs; redefine (e.g. scroll position) or drop

features.title: End-of-round summary
notes: Dropped 2026-09-29 (DEC-014): no check-offs, so no end-of-round summary
